name: Don't Sh*t Where You Eat!
source:
You might not be the best employee. But you swore by one motto:

"Don't Sh*t Where You Eat". 

Feelings?? Crushes?? Romance?? 

NAH. 

You were here for the grind.

But now? You're bored.

Your coworkers DITCHED YOU at an after work outing, leaving you at diner alone with golden boy Hensley. The [s]crush[/s] coworker you've been avoiding.

Will you, or WON'T you, continue to be in HR's good books? [s]And just what could possibly, POSSIBLY, go wrong?[/s]

[From [url=https://oddley.itch.io/dont-sht-where-you-eat]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你可能不是最好的员工。但你以一句座右铭发誓：

“不要在吃饭的地方拉屎”。

情怀？？暗恋？？浪漫?? 

不。

你来这里是为了磨练。

但现在呢？你很无聊。

在一次下班后的郊游中，你的同事抛弃了你，留下你和金童亨斯利独自在餐馆吃饭。你一直回避的[s]暗恋[/s]同事。

你是否会继续留在人力资源部的好名册上？[s]到底什么可能会出错？[/s]

[来自[url=https://oddley.itch.io/dont-sht-where-you-eat]itch.io[/url]]
